{{Quote|Hawkins, take Rawaat and check the north tower. If the prisoners have it, let me know and I'll send reinforcements.|Officer Mark Vempor|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Evacuation|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''Mark Vempor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]], he reported that [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] escaped from their cells and caused a terrible riot and many prison guards' family members were trapped in the intake lot. Since the guards wanted to get their families safety off world, Vempor asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual to prevent the prisoners from harming the families. The individual successfully defeated a number of enemy prisoners, allowing the armored vehicle to safely transport the civilians off world.
